Atlantic: from the 2017-18 season, analysts log developing-hurricane-force fixes before each event's first HF fix and storm-force fixes after its last. Lead/trail fixes per event: 0.00/0.00 before, 1.70/0.82 from then on. The storms did not change; the recorded track did. Deepening, duration and distance over the recorded track are not comparable across this boundary - use the HF-window figures (deep24, berg, bomb, hfDurH, hfDistNm, hfSpdKt).

Pacific: from the 2013-14 season, analysts log developing-hurricane-force fixes before each event's first HF fix and storm-force fixes after its last. Lead/trail fixes per event: 0.04/0.04 before, 0.88/0.86 from then on. The storms did not change; the recorded track did. Deepening, duration and distance over the recorded track are not comparable across this boundary - use the HF-window figures (deep24, berg, bomb, hfDurH, hfDistNm, hfSpdKt).

Explosive share (>= 1 Bergeron, of all events with an HF fix): on the recorded track 8.6% (2004-2016) -> 36.8% (2017-2025); on HF fixes only 6.8% -> 9.4%. Across the 44 season-basins, lead fixes per event correlate with the recorded-track share at r = +0.930 and with the HF-only share at r = +0.227.
